name: How do I choose the right location for my exterior kitchen?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right location for my exterior kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right location involves considering proximity to existing utilities (gas, water, electricity), ease of access from your indoor kitchen and dining areas, and sun/shade exposure throughout the day. It should be away from flammable structures and ideally offer a pleasant view or easy integration with your outdoor living space. Wind patterns and privacy from neighbors are also important factors for comfort and functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider utility access, proximity to indoor spaces, sun/shade, proximity to structures, views, wind patterns, and privacy when choosing a location.
